[attribute-language]
=== `@language` Code Language

Programming language in which this code is written, for example: “`javascript`”, for code written in “Javascript 3.0” (Note: The “3.0” can be recorded in the <<attribute-language-version,`@language-version`>> attribute.); or “`dtd`” for an XML DTD fragment.

#### Usage/Remarks
This attribute _does not_ record the name of a natural language, such as French. The attribute <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>> records natural languages.

#### OPTIONAL on elements:  <<element-code,`<code>`>>, 
                  <<element-inline-code,`<inline-code>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The lower case name of the programming or scripting language.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
